description: This file contains partial class definitions and extension methods related to Azure Storage clustering options, validators, and extension methods for configuring Azure Storage clustering in an Orleans project. It includes configuration classes, validators, and extension methods for setting up Azure Table storage for Orleans clustering.

classes.name: AzureStorageClusteringOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for Azure Storage clustering, including table name.

classes.name: AzureStorageGatewayOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for Azure Storage gateway, inheriting from AzureStorageOperationOptions.

classes.name: AzureStorageOperationOptions
classes.description: Base class providing configuration for Azure Storage operations, including table client options and policies.

classes.name: AzureStorageOperationOptionsValidator<TOptions>
classes.description: Generic validator for Azure Storage operation options.

classes.name: AzureStoragePolicyOptions
classes.description: Policy configuration options for Azure Storage, such as timeout and retry counts.

methods.name: ConfigureTableServiceClient
methods.description: Obsolete methods to configure the TableServiceClient with various parameters.

methods.name: UseAzureStorageClustering
methods.description: Extension methods for IClientBuilder and ISiloBuilder to set up Azure Storage clustering with configuration options.
